question: Is the spam removal_reason a per-record adjudication or a process label inherited from bulk/account-stratum actions?

note_user_was_blocked.interpretation: reason inherited from account-level block, not record-level determination

batches_le_5_rows.interpretation: upper bound on removals with a process signature compatible with individual review

spam_rows_with_citation_text.interpretation: the spam pathway writes no tombstone citation at all; export-level citation absence (91.30%) is largely a pathway artifact, not a record property

formulation: "88% spam" is a label distribution, not an adjudication record: 68% inherited from account blocks, ~90% applied in >=1,000-record same-day batches, <=0.1% with any process signature of per-record review. A blacklist constructed from this list inherits its label structure wholesale.
replication: derivable from the preserved ZD-S2 export (sha256 in the XR-E1 capture) by grouping removal_reason x removal_note x removal_date
